summary: A resident at {hotel} can check a new service charge against what used to come with the room.
realLife: The city's 2025 hotel order treated previously included services at the applicable reference date as covered by rent and barred separate charges for them under a different name.
gates: The case record identifies the covered unit, applicable reference date and previous service terms.
